paletteStudio.title: Color Palette Generator
paletteStudio.seoTitle: Color Palette Generator — Free Online Palette Maker
paletteStudio.description: Generate a harmonious color palette from one seed color. Check WCAG contrast, simulate color blindness, and copy CSS variables or Tailwind tokens — no signup.
paletteStudio.intro: A browser-based color palette generator that turns one seed color into a harmonious, readable palette you can copy or share.
paletteStudio.howTo: Start from a style preset or fine-tune a seed color and harmony rule, then copy any hex or export CSS and Tailwind tokens. The URL keeps your exact settings.
paletteStudio.seedHint: One color is all it takes — the rest is generated around it.
paletteStudio.harmonyHint: How the colors relate to your seed.
paletteStudio.copyHint: Click any swatch to copy its hex
paletteStudio.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text manually

presets.title: Style presets
presets.hint: One click applies a complete palette. Fine-tune anytime.

contrast.title: WCAG contrast
contrast.hint: Ratios show legibility on white and black. AA needs 4.5:1, AAA needs 7:1.

simulation.title: Color-blind preview
simulation.hint: Approximate simulation of common color vision deficiencies.

about.title: About StarRudder
about.description: StarRudder makes free tools that run in your browser. No account, no uploads, no stored data — just open a tool and use it.
about.body: Everything runs on your device: name generation, pixel avatars, emoji wallpapers and travel maps are built in the browser. We don't store your inputs, require an account, or send your results to a server.

randomName.title: Random Name Generator
randomName.description: Generate random full names in 14 languages with native scripts and browser pronunciation. Pick a language and style, then shuffle.
randomName.intro: A free random name generator for full names in 14 languages, written in native script and read aloud by your browser.
randomName.howTo: Choose a language and name style, then click Shuffle. Play the pronunciation to hear it, or share the result.
randomName.pronunciationFailed: Audio couldn't play. Try another browser.

pixelAvatar.title: Pixel Avatar Maker
pixelAvatar.description: Turn a seed into a unique pixel avatar online. Choose a style and palette, shuffle, then download a PNG — no signup.
pixelAvatar.intro: A pixel art avatar generator that turns a shareable seed into a unique profile picture you can export as PNG.
pixelAvatar.howTo: Pick a style and palette, keep or shuffle the seed, then click Download PNG. The same seed always recreates the same avatar.
pixelAvatar.styleHint: Each style has its own pixel density and level of detail.
pixelAvatar.seedHint: Keep the same seed to recreate the exact same avatar.

emojiWallpaper.title: Emoji Wallpaper Maker
emojiWallpaper.description: Make a 4K emoji wallpaper in your browser. Pick emoji, pattern and aspect ratio, then download PNG or JPG.
emojiWallpaper.intro: An emoji wallpaper maker that tiles your emoji into a 4K phone or desktop wallpaper.
emojiWallpaper.howTo: Choose an emoji set or enter your own, pick a pattern and ratio, then download a PNG or JPG.
emojiWallpaper.themeHint: Each set is a themed pile of emoji to tile with.
emojiWallpaper.emojiHint: Pick your own emoji to override the set. Up to 12; leave empty to use the set above.
emojiWallpaper.patternHint: How the emoji are laid out across the canvas.
emojiWallpaper.ratioHint: Every ratio exports at 4K or larger on the short edge.
emojiWallpaper.columnsHint: How many emoji fit across. Fewer means bigger emoji.
emojiWallpaper.seedHint: Keep the same seed to recreate the exact same wallpaper.

travelFootprint.title: Travel Footprint
travelFootprint.seoTitle: Travel Footprint Map — Plot & Export Routes
travelFootprint.description: Plot home and visited places on a travel map, draw animated routes, then export PNG or JSON. Runs in your browser.
travelFootprint.intro: A travel footprint map that plots your home and visited places, then draws routes between them.
travelFootprint.howTo: Set home, add places by clicking the map, searching, or entering coordinates, then style the lines and export PNG or data.
keywords: map with home and visited places
travelFootprint.mapError: The map couldn't load. You can still manage your footprints below.
travelFootprint.mapHint: Click the map to drop a point · drag a marker to fine-tune it
travelFootprint.homeHint: Click the map, search a place, or enter coordinates to set your home.
travelFootprint.locationFailed: Couldn't read your location. Try clicking the map instead.
travelFootprint.searchFailed: Place search is unavailable right now.
travelFootprint.coordInvalid: Enter a valid latitude (-90 to 90) and longitude (-180 to 180).
travelFootprint.spotEmpty: No footprints yet. Click the map, search a place, or enter coordinates.
travelFootprint.importFailed: That file isn't a valid travel footprint file.
travelFootprint.clearConfirm: Clear home and every footprint? This cannot be undone.

imageStudio.title: Image Converter
imageStudio.seoTitle: Image Converter — Convert PNG, JPG, WebP & More Online
imageStudio.description: Convert images between PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, ICO and BMP entirely in your browser. Batch convert, resize and compress locally — no uploads, no signup.
imageStudio.intro: A browser-only image converter that changes formats, resizes and compresses in batch — your files never leave the device.
imageStudio.howTo: Drop or paste images, choose a target format, tune quality or size, then download one image or the whole batch as a ZIP.
imageStudio.previewEmpty: Pick an image on the left.
imageStudio.pasteHint: Or paste a screenshot with Ctrl/Cmd + V.
imageStudio.formatsHint: SVG in · GIF single frame · ICO ≤ 256px

formatNotes.flatten: JPG · smaller files; transparency is filled with the background color.
formatNotes.modern: WebP · best balance of size and quality.
formatNotes.staticGif: GIF · one static frame, up to 256 colors.
formatNotes.icon: ICO · a single icon up to 256×256.

imageStudio.emptyHint: Add images above to get started.

feedback.failed: Some images could not be converted.
feedback.zipEmpty: Convert at least one image first.

imageStudio.privacyNote: Everything runs in this tab. Images are never uploaded or stored, and the share link contains settings only.

qrCodeGenerator.title: QR Code Generator
qrCodeGenerator.seoTitle: QR Code Generator — Free, Private, No Watermark
qrCodeGenerator.description: Create scannable QR codes in your browser. Customize colors, dot styles and a center logo, then export PNG or SVG. Nothing uploaded, no watermark.
qrCodeGenerator.intro: A browser-only QR code generator. Enter text or a link, tune the style, and export a clean code — nothing is uploaded or stored.
qrCodeGenerator.howTo: Type text or paste a URL, choose error correction, colors and dot style, then download a PNG or SVG. Add a small logo if you like.
qrCodeGenerator.levelHint: Higher levels survive damage but hold less data. Use H when adding a logo.
qrCodeGenerator.transparentHint: PNG only. SVG keeps a transparent fill when enabled.
qrCodeGenerator.empty: Enter content to generate a code.
qrCodeGenerator.tooLong: Content is too long for this error-correction level. Shorten it or lower the level.
qrCodeGenerator.lowContrast: Low contrast — the code may be hard to scan. Increase the difference between the two colors.
qrCodeGenerator.logoHint: Keep the logo small so the code stays scannable.
qrCodeGenerator.shareWarning: The share link contains the text you entered — only share it with people who should see it.
qrCodeGenerator.privacyNote: Everything runs in this tab. Your content and logo are never uploaded or stored; the logo is not included in the share link.

gradientWallpaper.title: Gradient Wallpaper Generator
gradientWallpaper.seoTitle: Gradient Wallpaper Generator — Free CSS Gradient Maker
gradientWallpaper.description: Design a gradient wallpaper in your browser. Drag color stops, switch linear/radial/conic, copy CSS or export high-res PNG. No upload, no account.
gradientWallpaper.intro: A browser-only gradient wallpaper maker. Blend up to five color stops, pick linear, radial or conic, then copy the CSS or download a high-resolution PNG — nothing is uploaded or stored.
gradientWallpaper.howTo: Choose a gradient type, drag or edit the color stops, set the angle or center, then copy the CSS or download a PNG wallpaper. The share link keeps your exact setup.
gradientWallpaper.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Select and copy the CSS manually.
gradientWallpaper.conicUnsupported: Conic gradients are not supported in this browser. Try a modern browser.
gradientWallpaper.stopsHint: Click the color bar to add a stop, drag handles to move them. Arrow keys nudge a focused handle; Delete removes it.
gradientWallpaper.ratioHint: Exported at full resolution. Preview is scaled to fit.
gradientWallpaper.seedHint: A seed recreates its original colors. Changing it replaces the color stops.
gradientWallpaper.showTextHint: Overlay sample text to check icon and text legibility.

asciiArt.title: ASCII Art Generator
asciiArt.seoTitle: ASCII Art Generator — Text & Image to ASCII Art
asciiArt.description: Turn text or an image into ASCII art in your browser. Pick fonts or image settings, copy the text or export a PNG. No signup, no upload.
asciiArt.intro: A browser-only ASCII art generator. Turn a short phrase into a character-built headline, or map a local image to characters. Copy the result as plain text or download a PNG — nothing is uploaded or stored.
asciiArt.howTo: Switch between Text and Image. For text, choose a font, spacing and alignment; for an image, set width, character ramp and tone. Copy the art or export a PNG; the share link keeps your settings.
asciiArt.inputHint: Use letters, numbers and basic punctuation. Chinese and emoji are replaced with ?.
asciiArt.imageDropHint: Drop an image here or paste with Ctrl+V. PNG, JPG, GIF and WebP work.
asciiArt.imageLoadFailed: Could not load that image. Try a local file or a CORS-enabled URL.
asciiArt.imageEmpty: Load an image to see it as ASCII art.
asciiArt.imageShareHint: Share links keep image settings, not the image itself. The image stays on your device.
asciiArt.backgroundHint: Changes the preview and the exported PNG; copied text stays plain.
asciiArt.empty: Type something to see your art.
asciiArt.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Select and copy the art manually.
asciiArt.downloadFailed: Could not export the PNG. Please try again.
asciiArt.privacyNote: Your text and images are converted on this device. Nothing is uploaded, saved or sent anywhere.

jsonToolkit.title: JSON Toolkit
jsonToolkit.seoTitle: JSON Formatter & Validator — Format, Validate, Convert
jsonToolkit.description: Format, validate and minify JSON in your browser. Convert JSON to CSV or TSV and back. No signup, no upload — your data never leaves your device.
jsonToolkit.intro: A browser-only JSON toolkit. Format, validate and minify JSON, or convert it to and from CSV/TSV. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
jsonToolkit.howTo: Paste JSON or drop a local file, choose indentation and key ordering, then copy the result. Switch to Convert to move between JSON and CSV/TSV. Share links keep your settings, not your data.
jsonToolkit.dropHint: Paste here or drop a local .json / .txt file. Nothing is uploaded.
jsonToolkit.sortHint: Recursive alphabetical order. Turn off to keep the original order.
jsonToolkit.minified: Minified JSON is ready to copy.
jsonToolkit.lossyHint: Nested values are kept as JSON text in a cell. CSV cells always import as strings.
jsonToolkit.invalidOutput: Fix the input to see the result.
jsonToolkit.shareHint: Share links contain settings only — never the text you entered.
jsonToolkit.privacyNote: Everything runs in this tab. Nothing is uploaded, saved or sent anywhere.
jsonToolkit.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Select and copy the text manually.

passwordGenerator.title: Password Generator
passwordGenerator.seoTitle: Password Generator — Free, Private, Runs in Your Browser
passwordGenerator.description: Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases in your browser. Cryptographically secure, nothing uploaded, no signup — copy any result in one click.
passwordGenerator.intro: A browser-only password and passphrase generator. It runs on your device with the Web Crypto API, so nothing is uploaded, saved or sent anywhere.
passwordGenerator.howTo: Pick a scenario preset, or open Customise to set length, character types, word count and separators. Copy a result with one click and paste it straight into your password manager.
passwordGenerator.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Select and copy the text manually.
passwordGenerator.entropyLine: {bits} bits of entropy · local CSPRNG · zero uploads
passwordGenerator.weakHint: Short for a guessable secret — raise the length or add words.
passwordGenerator.presetsHint: One click sets the mode and every parameter. Fine-tune anytime.
passwordGenerator.customHint: Changing anything here switches the preset to your own settings.
passwordGenerator.lengthHint: Longer is stronger. Twelve characters or more is a sensible floor.
passwordGenerator.minPerTypeHint: Guarantees at least this many of each enabled type, then shuffles the result.
passwordGenerator.customCharsetHint: When filled, only these characters are used.
passwordGenerator.wordCountHint: Six words is about 77 bits; four is only about 52.
passwordGenerator.batchHint: Every result is independent. Copy them one at a time.
passwordGenerator.emptyCharset: Pick at least one character type to generate a password.
passwordGenerator.generateFailed: This browser cannot provide a secure random source. Try a modern browser over HTTPS.
passwordGenerator.howItWorksBody: Characters and words are drawn with crypto.getRandomValues and rejection sampling, so every value is equally likely. Entropy is length × log2(pool size); with a minimum per type the real figure is slightly lower. Nothing is written to the URL, storage or analytics.
passwordGenerator.privacyNote: Generated in this tab and never stored — paste it somewhere safe right away. The URL keeps your settings only, never the secret.

unixTimestampConverter.title: Unix Timestamp Converter
unixTimestampConverter.description: Convert Unix timestamps to dates and back in your browser. Seconds, milliseconds, microseconds and nanoseconds, UTC and any IANA time zone — nothing uploaded.
unixTimestampConverter.intro: A browser-only Unix timestamp converter. Paste an epoch value or an ISO 8601 date and see the same instant in every format, in your time zone and in UTC.
unixTimestampConverter.howTo: Paste a Unix timestamp or an ISO 8601 date with a time zone offset. The tool detects seconds, milliseconds, microseconds or nanoseconds, shows UTC and your chosen time zone, and lets you copy any result in one click.
unixTimestampConverter.zoneNote: A timestamp has no time zone. Changing this only changes how the same instant is displayed.
unixTimestampConverter.copyFailed: Could not access the clipboard. Select and copy the text manually.
unixTimestampConverter.errorEmpty: Paste a Unix timestamp or an ISO 8601 date to begin.
unixTimestampConverter.errorInvalid: That is not a Unix timestamp or an offset-bearing ISO 8601 date.
unixTimestampConverter.errorOutOfRange: That value is outside the supported range, so no date is shown rather than a wrong one.
unixTimestampConverter.unitHeuristicHint: Unit detection uses digit magnitude and is a convenience, not a guarantee: short values, negatives and far-future dates can be misread. Override it above.
unixTimestampConverter.negativeHint: Negative values are instants before 1970-01-01 UTC.
unixTimestampConverter.year2038Hint: Signed 32-bit Unix seconds overflow here (2038-01-19 03:14:07 UTC).
unixTimestampConverter.privacyNote: Everything is computed in this tab. Nothing is uploaded, saved, or sent to a server.
unixTimestampConverter.privacyHashNote: The link may contain your input after a #, which browsers never send in a request — sharing it stays private.
unixTimestampConverter.howItWorksBody: Values are parsed as BigInt and normalised to nanoseconds, so microsecond and nanosecond timestamps never lose precision. Formatting uses the browser Intl API with IANA time zone rules, including daylight saving. Unix time ignores leap seconds by definition.
